name: GSK1360707F
summary: GSK1360707F is a potent and selective triple reuptake inhibitor. It is chemically related to amitifadine and NS-2359 (GSK-372,475). Until recently, it was under development for the treatment of major depressive disorder; its development was put on hold for strategic reasons.
